integrity: All mathematics and reproducibility files are embedded completely in the accompanying record. The six small-parameter inequalities are certified by rational arithmetic, and the remaining infinite range is analytic.
scientific_limitations: The strict second-derivative comparison is proved for the two specified balanced single-word families for every integer k at least 2; it does not establish extremality among arbitrary words. Previously known border identities and entropy ordering are credited. No independent external assessment is claimed.
title: Entropy–variance order reversal for two balanced forbidden-word shifts
